# .github Directory

This directory contains GitHub-specific documentation and configuration files for the Wjire.Lib repository.

## Files

- **CHAT_CONVERSATIONS.md**: Documents important chat conversations and discussions related to the project. This file serves as a way to "synchronize" chat discussions with GitHub by manually recording them.

## Purpose

The files in this directory help with:
- Project documentation
- Tracking important discussions
- Maintaining project history and context
- Facilitating collaboration

## Usage

Feel free to add to these files as needed to document important aspects of the project.
